{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVMdNDs8AAAABZfwqcg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BnXy5zhDG7LY", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BnXy5", "number": 37, "title": "Support a bounded PMX 2.1 QDEF profile through glTF, VMD/VPD and Demo", "body": "## Problem

Valid PMX 2.1 QDEF models cannot enter the animated pipeline. `parsePMX()` reports the pinned parser's version-header failure, and `createBDEFSkin()` independently rejects type-4 influences. Changing a header or treating QDEF as BDEF4 would not reproduce its deformation.

## Expected outcome

Provide an explicit, opt-in QDEF profile spanning valid PMX input, a runtime-independent glTF extension draft, converter, reusable Three.js integration and built Demo. Support rigid joint palettes and mixed BDEF/SDEF/QDEF geometry, existing vertex morphs, both VMD motions and both VPD poses. Preserve current Toon, Outline and independent core fallback conventions.

This Issue does not complete general PMX 2.1 support or original-MMD fidelity. Remaining morph families, IK/append ordering, physics, scene animation and representative compatibility remain mandatory overall work. VMD and VPD remain mandatory.

## Context

Baseline: `f24e17b3c3e15d6cbacfd627ca516bb79954fd2d`; local checkout and remote main match. Open Issue and PR collections were empty at inspection.

Dependencies remain Three.js 0.186.1, three-mmd 0.1.2, mmd-parser 1.1.4 and glTF Transform 4.5.1. Existing SDEF code supplies instance-scoped loader/exporter hooks, CPU queries, TSL deformation and shared Outline integration; extend these narrowly without introducing a general deformation framework.

The [PMX format-author document, mirrored here](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hirakuni45/glfw3_app/master/glfw3_app/docs/PMX_spec.txt) identifies QDEF as four-influence dual-quaternion deformation and describes additional 2.1 sections. It omits the algorithm details and is not measured MMD execution. [Kavan's reference shader](https://users.cs.utah.edu/~ladislav/dq/dqs.cg) supplies general blending, antipodality and rotational-normal equations; its choices are not proof of MMD-specific behavior. Define unresolved choices as an explicit project profile.

[Core glTF](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KhronosGroup/glTF/main/specification/2.0/Specification.adoc) supplies joints, inverse binds, weights, morphs and animation, but specifies linear blend skinning. Reuse that data and define only missing QDEF behavior. [Official Three.js skinning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r186/src/nodes/accessors/Skinning.js) and [NodeMaterial](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r186/src/materials/nodes/NodeMaterial.js) establish palette integration and morph-before-skinning order; acceptance uses the repository lockfile.

Retain the existing correction: earlier planning assumed QDEF first failed at a vertex. Repository regressions and saved evidence establish an earlier binary-2.1 header rejection plus a separate unsupported type-4 branch. Correct support must address both; the header-modified probe remains invalid input.

PR #36's final-head hosted logs establish 49 Node passes, 18 browser passes and two optional WebGPU skips. The merged-commit browser step remains reported in progress. Test presence and merge status alone establish neither execution nor fidelity; this planning inspection ran no suites and adds no independent AI re-review.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Accept actual binary PMX 2.1 QDEF through API and CLI, preserving source version, exact supported text encodings, coordinate conversion and units. Cover UTF-16LE/UTF-8 and supported index widths. Do not relabel headers or silently approximate unsupported source records. Retain PMX 2.0 behavior.
- [ ] Document and enforce a bounded 2.1 input profile: existing supported triangle data plus QDEF, with a required zero soft-body count. Reject unsupported 2.1 drawing flags, flip/impulse morph records and nonzero joint types with section/index diagnostics before emitting output. Cover missing/truncated tails, invalid counts/references and unsupported versions. Existing 2.0 omissions retain explicit loss reports; claim no general 2.1 support.
- [ ] Add a focused extension draft with schema, complete example and executable semantic fixtures. Define selection/defaults, accessor layouts, spaces, influence handling, dual-quaternion construction/blending/normalization, active sign reference, exact sign ties, near-degenerate behavior, rotational normals/tangents and rigid-transform limits. Specify coexistence with SDEF without applying skinning twice. Preserve unique active glTF joint indices and document weight normalization as a converter/profile policy rather than a mandatory PMX or FLOAT glTF rule.
- [ ] Produce deterministic, validator-clean GLB and unpacked glTF using core joints/binds/weights and explicit QDEF selection. Define optional versus required extension behavior. An ordinary loader must retain a usable, explicitly approximate BDEF4 fallback; measure a nontrivial difference from QDEF. Preserve strict existing conversion modes and diagnostics.
- [ ] Implement reusable loader/runtime/exporter integration for Toon, plugin-enabled PBR and Outline. Morphs precede deformation. CPU vertex queries, recomputed bounds and actual GPU positions/normals agree with the profile. Cover nonidentity rigid binds, common scene placement, palette buffer/texture paths, multiple instances, replacement and disposal. Unsupported scale/shear/reflection and malformed payloads produce actionable errors. Export/reload rebuilds accessor references and preserves posed QDEF behavior.
- [ ] Use two attributed synthetic rigs with distinct geometry/hierarchy and mixed weighting. Exercise four active influences, inactive references, duplicate influences, endpoint weights, translations, noncommuting rotations, quaternion sign changes and near-180-degree/tie cases. Compare against independent scalar/analytic predictions that do not call production deformation code. For these fixtures require CPU position error at most `2e-6 m`, GPU position-component error at most `1e-4 m`, normalized-normal component error at most `5e-4`, and at most 128 raster pixels differing by more than two encoded RGB levels. Retain existing regression thresholds and coverage.
- [ ] Carry both `combined-a.vmd` and `combined-b.vmd`, and both `pose-a.vpd` and `pose-b.vpd`, through both rigs. Cover byte-loaded motion/pose application, converted GLB/glTF, posed export/reload, active vertex morphs and reset. Built Demo observations cover all two-rig × two-motion × three-source combinations, both poses, fractional seeking, VPD-to-VMD ownership, Toon/PBR, Outline, approximate-fallback comparison/restoration, failure recovery and replacement/disposal. Use rendered-state acknowledgement plus canvas evidence; retain existing SDEF acceptance.
- [ ] Coordinator runs and reports actual results using existing tooling: `npm ci`, `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, Chromium installation where needed, `PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_CHANNEL=chromium npm run test:browser`, `npm run check:links` and `git diff --check`. Integrate new checks into these commands. Record source commit, environment, numerical/raster maxima, source hashes, failures/skips and attribution. Distinguish executed results from tests merely present and general-algorithm conformance from original-MMD measurements. Preserve notices for adapted code.
- [ ] Update pipeline, plugin, Demo, fixture and validation documentation. Evidence-backed corrections to AI-authored requirements may proceed without human approval or independent AI re-review: retain the old assumption, corrected requirement, primary source and rationale. Do not weaken acceptance to accommodate unfinished implementation or failing checks.

## Optional validation

Native WebGPU measurements, lawful representative QDEF assets and controlled original-MMD measurements would improve applicability. Keep their provenance and results separate from synthetic project-profile conformance; unavailable measurements do not justify parity claims.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed MMD/glTF model, VMD animation and
VPD pose reproduction goal. Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance
criteria when primary specifications or measured evidence establish the correction.
Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
